_editing: Add new releases to the front of the 'releases' array. The first release is featured on the home page. Add cover art to /public/releases and set 'cover' to its path (e.g. "/releases/another-time.jpg") — when 'cover' is empty the site renders a styled vinyl disc instead. 'year' and per-track 'duration'/'links' are optional and only render when set. 'totalTracks' lets the site show the album size even while the tracklist below is still being filled in. Only add links that actually exist — every entry renders as a live link.

releases.title: Another Time
releases.description: The debut 13-track digital album from Ange's Rant — a homage to the artists that shaped Ange's musical journey, made possible by the creative contribution and skills of his talented musician friends. Funk, soul and disco/pop with an 80's flavour, front to back.

links.label: Buy on the official store — AU $1.99 a track
